content.title: About
content.content: Diet ginger ale is a calorie‑free carbonated soft drink with a bright ginger flavor and mild sweetness, achieved through artificial sweeteners. It is commonly served chilled as a refreshing beverage.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Ginger ale originated in the United States in the late 19th century as an alternative to traditional ginger beer.
Diet versions appeared in the 1970s alongside the rise of low‑calorie products.
The formula often includes sodium benzoate as a preservative and citric acid for flavor balance.
Some brands use real ginger extract, while others rely on flavorings.
The drink is frequently used in non‑alcoholic cocktails because of its spicy note.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Ginger is known to ease nausea and stimulate digestive processes.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The diet version contains virtually 0 kcal, making it suitable for weight management.

items.title: Sugar‑free
items.content: Absence of sugar is beneficial for people with diabetes or those limiting sugar intake.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Like any carbonated beverage, it helps maintain fluid balance.

items.title: Antioxidant effect
items.content: Brands that add real ginger extract provide gingerol, an antioxidant compound.

items.title: Sensitivity to artificial sweeteners
items.content: Some individuals may experience gastrointestinal discomfort from aspartame or sucralose.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Preservatives and flavorings can increase sodium levels, which is a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Excessive consumption of carbonated drinks may cause bloating and stomach discomfort.

items.title: Ginger allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to ginger can occur.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve chilled as a refreshing drink, use in non‑alcoholic cocktails, mixers with juices, or in recipes that call for a ginger flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 7‑10 days.
